rendered: The review does not recommend this. It argues against it: recovering current collectors such as Cu and Al matters because Cu smelting is a key source of SOx and other greenhouse gas emissions in the cradle-to-gate stages of the battery life cycle. From this it concludes that dissolving Al[1] in an alkaline solution is not a sustainable separation method[2]. The alkaline-dissolution route is therefore rejected on sustainability grounds, not recommended. For separating electrode materials from Al foil, the review instead points to dissolving or decomposing the PVDF binder with a solvent such as NMP or DMF, or by thermal treatment.
